text_blocks.snippet: "Asdf" is most commonly a keyboard smash used as online filler text, a runtime version manager for developers via asdf-vm.com, or the name of the popular web cartoon asdfmovie. It can also refer to technical tools or military units.
snippet_highlighted_words: a keyboard smash used as online filler text

list.snippet: Keyboard Smash: A quick roll across the middle row of a QWERTY keyboard (asdf or asdfghjkl) to type nonsense or express strong feelings.
Version Manager: A command-line tool like asdf that manages multiple programming language runtimes (like Node.js, Python, or Ruby) in one place.
Internet Animation: The sketch comedy YouTube series asdfmovie known for absurd humor and catchphrases.
Lisp Build System: Another System Definition Facility (ASDF), the standard build and load tool for Common Lisp code.
Acronyms: Shorthand for groups like the Alaska State Defense Force or Japan's Air Self-Defense Force.
